title: Limited Drop Alert Video Template | AIVideosUGC
description: Drive urgency for a small release or restock with a drop alert video from one product photo. Add your date, quantity and notify link after download.
h1: Limited Drop Alert Videos for Restocks and New Drops
lead: Create a timely alert from one product photo, then add the exact date, stock count and notify link after download. You can prepare the next restock or small release without arranging a shoot for every drop.
steps_h2: How to Make an AI Limited Drop Alert Video in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Turn one product photo into a clear drop moment, then add the confirmed release details.

steps.d: Start with one clear photo of the product in the limited drop. Keep its full shape and color visible.
Choose a reveal, unboxing or in-use moment. Name the one action that should make the release feel timely.
Download the finished alert. Add the confirmed date, quantity and notify link in your editor.

faq.a: No. Use the format for apparel, accessories, cosmetics, or a small home goods release. Keep one product and one clear action per run.

faq.q: Does AIVideosUGC add music or captions?
faq.a: AIVideosUGC does not add narration, music, or captions. Add a track, recorded narration, and text in your editor after download.

faq.q: What video length fits a limited drop alert?
faq.a: Use 6 seconds for one product-and-date beat, 10 or 15 seconds for a reveal plus call to action, and 30 seconds for a longer sequence. Add the exact stock count and drop date after download.

faq.q: Can I show a live countdown?
faq.a: Add the countdown as an editable text layer or platform element after download, so the time is always current.

faq.q: What ratio works for a drop alert?
faq.a: 9:16 fits TikTok and Reels; make a 1:1 version for feeds. Clips cost 24, 40, 60 or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds.

faq.q: Can the video include the stock quantity?
faq.a: Keep the quantity as a text layer you add yourself, so it can be updated as stock changes.

faq.q: Can I create a second limited-drop video from the same source photo?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the coral trail shoe as the reference, then change one setting or camera move at a time. Add the current date, price and notify link after download so each version stays easy to update.

faq.q: Can I run the alert as a paid ad during the drop window?
faq.a: Yes. Videos you make can run in your own paid ads, social posts and restock emails, with no AIVideosUGC watermark on the download. You remain responsible for availability, claims and the disclosures the platform requires.

faq.q: How do I stop showing sold-out urgency?
faq.a: Pause or update the ad and replace the quantity layer when the drop sells out, switching to a restock notify message if another release is planned. A limited alert should not keep running after the live number changes.

visual.overview: Show the limited-release product in a clear reveal, then add timing and availability after download.

steps.sourceHint: Show the full shoe shape and color in a clear view.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and preserve the coral trail shoes shape, color and outsole exactly. An adult hiker ties the uploaded coral trail shoes on a rocky trail, then stands to show the tread and full pair. Use a vertical medium frame with one slow push-in; end on both shoes steady in the center with safe space above for an editable date layer. Sound: lace pull, gravel steps and quiet wind; no music.
